name: What is the typical process for vinyl siding replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for vinyl siding replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The vinyl siding replacement process usually begins with an initial consultation and estimate. Once approved, the existing siding is removed, and any necessary repairs to the underlying sheathing are made. A weather-resistant barrier is then installed, followed by the new vinyl siding panels, starting from the bottom up. Finally, trim pieces, soffit, and fascia are installed, and a thorough clean-up is performed.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, removal of old siding, sheathing repair, weather barrier installation, new vinyl siding, trim, and clean-up.
